contracts: Validation passes only when exactly six materially distinct Matrix Case IDs are present and every case has both Stable and Candidate records whose fixture/state identity remains unchanged from start through completion and whose evidence is attributable.
selector_intents: Select a Matrix Case fixture with its Stable or Candidate subject record omitted; validation must fail for incomplete subject coverage.
Select a case fixture whose Stable or Candidate subject identity hash differs between execution start and completion; validation must fail immutability enforcement.
Select execution evidence with missing or mismatched Matrix Case/subject attribution; validation must fail traceability checking.
